purpose: Teach: 盛り込ま/所定/同月/両側/過大/前々/附属/米ドル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新事業計画に複数の選択肢を盛り込まないとな
lines.en: We need to build multiple options into our new business plan.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Crisp attack on the opening. Even pacing, no hesitation. The tone of someone thinking aloud but with authority—not asking, stating a requirement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。所定の様式で報告書を提出します
lines.en: Understood. I'll submit the report in the standard format.
lines.style: Steady, attentive. Light emphasis on 'understood'—showing he's tracking. Businesslike pace, no excess. The tone of someone taking notes mentally, ready to move to the next task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、同月内に決算を締めろ
lines.en: Close the books by the end of this month.
lines.style: Firm and economical. Sharp attack on 'close.' Measured pace. No elaboration—just the directive. The weight of expectation without harshness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。道路の両側に看板を出します
lines.en: Understood. I'll move forward with what we've been planning.
lines.style: Composed, agreeable. Slightly faster pace—showing readiness to execute. No pushback, just confirmation. The tone of someone who knows what's expected and is already moving.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 過大な期待は社員に酷だ
lines.en: Unrealistic expectations wear people down. That's not what we do here.
lines.style: Quieter than before. Thoughtful, almost reflective. Slight pause before 'wear people down.' The tone shifts from directive to something more human—acknowledging the human cost beneath the business.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。前々から計画していた件を進めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll accelerate the work we had planned for earlier.
lines.style: Alert, responsive. Tempo picks up slightly—showing he's ready to act. Clean, no hedging. The tone of someone following the thread of the conversation and already ahead of the ask.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、大学附属研究所と連携しろ
lines.en: Partner with the university research institute. Make it happen.
lines.style: Authoritative, clear. Crisp delivery on 'partner'—setting a new direction. Even pace. The finality of someone who has decided something important and expects execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。米ドル建ての契約も見直します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also review our USD-denominated contracts.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient. Light emphasis on 'also'—showing anticipation and breadth of thinking. Fast, clean pace. The tone of someone wrapping up, already cycling through implications and next steps.
